name: reviewpilot
description: Open-source PR reviewer bot: an agent that reads the code it needs, verifies every finding, and posts only what it can prove.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
